title: From User Recognition to Activity Counting: An Identity-Agnostic Approach to Multi-User WiFi Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2604.16572v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) enables device-free human activity recognition, but multi-user methods typically assume a fixed set of known users and degrade on unseen individuals. We reformulate multi-user recognition as identity-agnostic activity counting, estimating how many users perform each activity without assigning actions to individuals. For a controlled comparison, identity-dependent predictions are converted to activity counts and evaluated with the same integer-valued metrics using a shared pipeline that differs only in output head and objective. On WiMANS, identity-agnostic counting achieves lower integer-count MAE than derived identity-dependent counts (0.0815 versus 0.0909 on a 0-5 count scale) despite using coarser supervision. translated_title: 从用户识别到活动计数：一种身份无关的多用户WiFi感知方法
translated_abstract: WiFi信道状态信息（CSI）使得无设备人体活动识别成为可能，但现有的多用户方法通常假设一组固定的已知用户，在面对未见过的个体时性能会下降。我们将多用户识别重新表述为身份无关的活动计数，即估计有多少用户在执行每种活动，而无需将动作分配给特定个体。为了进行受控比较，我们将依赖身份的预测转换为活动计数，并使用仅输出头和目标函数不同的共享流水线，以相同的整数值指标进行评估。在WiMANS数据集上，尽管使用了更粗粒度的监督，身份无关计数所实现的整数计数平均绝对误差（MAE）仍低于由依赖身份预测导出的计数（在0-5计数范围内分别为0.0815和0.0909）。这一优势在所有八种环境-频段条件下均成立，而导出计数仅在精确匹配准确率方面领先。在留出用户评估中，依赖身份方法的宏F1显著下降
tldr: 该论文提出将多用户WiFi感知从“识别具体用户”重新表述为“身份无关的活动计数”，仅估计执行各活动的用户数量而无需识别个体，在WiMANS数据集上以更粗粒度的监督实现了更低的计数误差，并在跨环境条件和留出用户评估中展现出更好的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates multi-user WiFi sensing from identity recognition to identity-agnostic activity counting—estimating how many users perform each activity without assigning actions to individuals—achieving lower counting error than identity-dependent methods on WiMANS despite coarser supervision, and demonstrating better generalization across environments and to unseen users.
